analysis.description: A large, stylized number '7' with a glossy, three-dimensional appearance. The main body of the number is a vibrant red with a shiny, reflective surface that catches light, creating highlights and shadows. It is outlined with a thick, golden-yellow border that has a metallic sheen. The top left corner of the number has a small, white, sparkly embellishment, resembling a star or a glittery highlight. The number is set against a plain white background.
